## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
- Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
- Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

## Mobile browser games

- Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
- Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
- Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
- Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable anime waifu roleplay chat game where the player runs a harem of customizable female characters who help with daily needs, with character pictures.

## Requirements
- Build the game now without clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them upon completion.
- Include pictures of female characters.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (viewport no wider than 1280px) and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Character portraits are generated as customizable, layered SVG illustrations rather than relying on external image assets.

## Work State

### Completed
- Created `js/portraits.js` with anime portrait generation, customizable hairstyles, hair and eye colors, outfits, accessories, and expressions.
- Created `preview.html` to display six sample portraits for visual inspection.

### Active
- Build the playable game interface and mechanics around the portrait system.
- Run the app and verify its visuals and functionality.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect `js/portraits.js` and run the local preview to verify portraits render correctly.
2. Build the game UI and gameplay, including character customization, roleplay chat, daily needs, and persistent progression.
3. Test at desktop and mobile sizes; save and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot.
4. Summarize assumptions and test results when finished.

## Relevant Files
- `js/portraits.js`: SVG portrait renderer and character customization options.
- `preview.html`: Portrait preview page.
- `start.sh`: Project startup entry point.
- `README.md`: Project information.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- No game UI or gameplay implementation exists yet.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable anime-inspired roleplay and household-life game where the player gets to know and care for customizable adult female housemates.
- Include character pictures and support persistent progression.

## Requirements
- Build without clarification; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them at completion.
- Include pictures of female characters.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (viewport no wider than 1280px) and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Character portraits use customizable, layered SVG illustrations instead of external image assets.
- The game is framed as cozy, non-explicit adult housemates sharing daily routines and conversations.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added `index.html` and a responsive visual design in `styles.css`.
- Added SVG anime portrait rendering and customization options in `js/portraits.js`; `preview.html` displays example portraits.
- Started implementing game state and UI rendering in `js/game.js`, including seeded housemates, localStorage save loading, navigation, overview, housemate cards, and daily schedule views.

### Active
- Finish `js/game.js`: chat and message interactions, daily task rewards and progression, housemate creation/customization, settings, and modal/action handlers.
- Run the app and verify interactions and visuals on desktop and mobile, including the requested latest small JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue implementing the remaining game logic and event handlers in `js/game.js`.
2. Run the app, fix runtime issues, and test gameplay and save persistence.
3. Check desktop and mobile layouts; save and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.
4. Summarize assumptions and test results.

## Relevant Files
- `js/game.js`: In-progress game UI, state, and gameplay implementation.
- `js/portraits.js`: SVG portrait renderer and character customization options.
- `index.html`: Main app shell and navigation.
- `styles.css`: Responsive game styling.
- `preview.html`: Portrait preview page.
- `start.sh`: Project startup entry point.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- `js/game.js` currently references action handlers and renderers not yet implemented; continue from its existing contents.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable anime-inspired household-life roleplay game with customizable adult female housemates, portraits, and persistent progression.

## Requirements
- Build without clarification; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them at completion.
- Include pictures of female characters.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (viewport no wider than 1280px) and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Use customizable layered SVG portraits instead of external image assets.
- Keep the game cozy and non-explicit, focused on adult housemates’ routines and conversations.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added responsive app shell and styles in `index.html` and `styles.css`.
- Added SVG anime portrait rendering and customization options in `js/portraits.js`; `preview.html` shows example portraits.
- Implemented game state, localStorage saves, overview, housemate cards, daily schedule, chat and message replies, task rewards, day progression, housemate invitation/customization, settings, save export/reset, and navigation in `js/game.js`.
- `node --check js/game.js` produced no errors.

### Active
- Run the app and verify interactions, persistence, runtime behavior, and desktop/mobile layouts.
- Save and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot; fix any issues found.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Start the app and test navigation, chat, daily tasks/day progression, housemate invite/customization, and save persistence.
2. Check for missing or mismatched styles and fix any runtime or responsive layout issues.
3. Capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px.
4. Summarize assumptions and test results.

## Relevant Files
- `js/game.js`: Gameplay state, views, chat, tasks, housemate management, and settings.
- `js/portraits.js`: SVG portraits and appearance options.
- `index.html`: Main app shell and navigation.
- `styles.css`: Responsive visual design.
- `preview.html`: Portrait preview page.
- `start.sh`: Project startup entry point.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Visual and gameplay verification has not yet been performed.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable anime-inspired household-life roleplay game with customizable adult female housemates, portraits, and persistent progression.

## Requirements
- Build without clarification; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them at completion.
- Include pictures of female characters.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (viewport no wider than 1280px) and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Use customizable layered SVG portraits instead of external image assets.
- Keep the game cozy and non-explicit, focused on adult housemates’ routines and conversations.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created responsive app shell, styles, SVG portrait generator, portrait preview, and game systems for household overview, daily tasks, chats, day progression, housemate customization/invites, local save, export, and reset.
- Added chat flows, modal UI logic, task rewards, and progression handlers to `js/game.js`.
- `node --check js/game.js` and `node --check js/portraits.js` passed.

### Active
- Verify that the app runs and interactions work, including navigation, chat, daily tasks, invitations/customization, and save persistence.
- Fix any CSS mismatches or responsive/runtime problems.
- Capture and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- Browser verification is still pending; `./start.sh` timed out after 1 second, and available stylesheet selectors suggest newly added UI classes may not match the existing styles (for example, `.game-modal` has no matching selector).

## Next Move
1. Inspect relevant existing CSS class names and add/fix styles for newly added chat, modal, customization, settings, and accessibility elements.
2. Start the static app with sufficient runtime and test gameplay plus localStorage persistence.
3. Capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot within the viewport limit; fix any issues.
4. Summarize assumptions and test results.

## Relevant Files
- `js/game.js`: Gameplay state, navigation, chats, tasks, housemate management, and settings.
- `js/portraits.js`: SVG portraits and appearance options.
- `index.html`: App shell and navigation.
- `styles.css`: Current UI styling and responsive rules.
- `preview.html`: Portrait preview page.
- `start.sh`: Project startup entry point.
- `/home/runner/work/_temp/omgithub-runtime/scripts/default-start.mjs`: Static server runner used by `start.sh`.
- `/home/runner/work/_temp/omgithub-runtime/scripts/default-capture.mjs`: Existing screenshot capture runner; outputs PNG rather than the requested JPEG.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Existing stylesheet includes older class names such as `.modal` and `.wide`, while the newly added modal markup uses `.game-modal` and `.modal-wide`.
- The capture script saves PNGs; use a JPEG-compatible capture approach or convert the captured image before inspection.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable anime-inspired household-life roleplay game with customizable adult female housemates, portraits, and persistent progression.

## Requirements
- Build without clarification; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them at completion.
- Include pictures of female characters.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (viewport no wider than 1280px) and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Use customizable layered SVG portraits instead of external image assets.
- Keep the game cozy and non-explicit, focused on adult housemates’ routines and conversations.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the responsive app shell, SVG portraits, overview, daily tasks, chats, day progression, housemate customization/invites, local save, export, and reset.
- Added CSS for the current modal, customization, settings, and chat markup in `styles.css`.
- `node --check js/game.js` and `node --check js/portraits.js` passed.

### Active
- Verify the app in a browser, exercise navigation/gameplay and localStorage persistence, and capture/inspect the latest JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px.

### Blocked
- Browser verification is pending; starting the project server via `start.sh` timed out, and a direct server launch did not respond at `http://127.0.0.1:3000/`.

## Next Move
1. Get the static app server running and verify the page loads without errors.
2. Test navigation, chat, task completion/day progression, housemate customization/invites, and save persistence.
3. Capture and inspect a JPEG screenshot within the viewport limit, then report assumptions and test results.

## Relevant Files
- `js/game.js`: Gameplay state, navigation, chats, tasks, housemate management, and settings.
- `styles.css`: App styling, including recently added selectors for current modal and chat markup.
- `js/portraits.js`: SVG portraits and appearance options.
- `index.html`: App shell and navigation.
- `start.sh`: Project startup entry point.
- `/home/runner/work/_temp/omgithub-runtime/scripts/default-start.mjs`: Static server runner used by `start.sh`.
- `/home/runner/work/_temp/omgithub-runtime/scripts/default-capture.mjs`: Screenshot runner; outputs PNG rather than JPEG.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; project files are untracked.
- The capture script outputs PNG, so JPEG capture may require converting its screenshot.
- `./start.sh` and direct server launch attempts timed out; the server has not yet been confirmed running.
